title: C: Arithmetic Operations
description: Perform addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and modulo operations on two integers. Print each result.

steps.title: Basic Arithmetic
steps.description: Declare `int a = 15, b = 4`. Compute and print: a + b, a - b, a * b, a / b, and a % b. Label each output clearly.
hints: Integer division truncates the decimal part.

verification.failureMessage: Compute and print sum, difference, product, quotient, and remainder
